text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Hehe... I should hope so.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I strive to remain calm and attentive...
Yet I can
feel the adrenaline building.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is right in front of me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The voting results came in the other day,
securing
Grass Wonder's chance to run
in the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Of course, Марузенски is on the list of

participants as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Grass's long-awaited battle with the
Beast is
finally here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: At least, that's what we thought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски is withdrawing from the
Arima Kinen?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yes... It seems she hurt herself during
training.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
And that's not all—it looks like she was
planning
for the Arima Kinen to be her
final send-off
before moving on to the
Dream Trophy League.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
So you're saying... I won't have a chance
to face
her in the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: It looks to be that way.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
And what a shame it is too! I was so
excited to see
the Beast and her
Successor go head to head.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: I was all set to write the article for the ages covering it. Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
We had planned to discuss our strategy
to beat
Марузенски today, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: So my goal... is forever out of reach.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер's words come out as a

barely-audible whisper... I've never
heard her
sound so broken.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The chance to overcome the Beast... To
break
away from her looming shadow...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: That chance... will never come again.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: We haven't the time to sulk, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The starting gates will open regardless
of who's in
them. We must be prepared
for the Arima Kinen,
yes?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: So I think...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I think I need to go for a run.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
But Грасс Вандер doesn't even look
back as she
takes off at full speed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер is tough—too tough to let
herself
cry where I can see her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She needs her time alone. I understand
that, but
still...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And then, suddenly...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Is Grass here, by any
chance?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Looks like it's just you right now,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
What's kicking? ...is what I'd usually say,
but I
guess this is no time for
pleasantries.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry about the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I know how hard you and Grass have
been
working to get ready for it.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I'm deeply sorry I won't be able to run.
...That's all
I've come to say.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Her injury was an accident, I'm sure. She
isn't to
blame.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But when I consider how much this
meant to Grass
Wonder... I can't help
but feel horribly let down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Is there any chance you'll stay in the Twinkle
Series?

text_block_list.text: ...Unfortunately, I'm afraid not.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I made up my mind to go to the Dream
Trophy
Series a long time ago.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Besides...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You want the two of us to race, don't
you?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But if you ask me... now isn't the right
time.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Grass and I shouldn't go head to head
just yet.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: When I saw the Japan Cup, I just knew.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: That's my little secret.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: But, hey. Grass will be fine. Just peachy.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: After all...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
There's one important thing she's always
had tons
and tons of. Something I never
had, no matter
how I longed for it!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
